title: OverlayState
description: Schema for live state synchronized across OBS Studio browser source overlays.

broadcast_type.description: Broadcast archetype: rewatch (The Sound Above), errata (solos/readings/demos), or dialogue (invited guests).

lower_third_autohide.description: Optional auto-hide delay in seconds before lower-third card transitions off-screen.

lower_third_layout.description: Lower-third layout presentation: standard card or minimal top HUD status bar.

errata.description: Metadata for Errata broadcasts: readings, concept breakdowns, demos, or archival artifacts.

title.description: Topic, essay title, or chapter name.

citation.description: Author, book, paper, or provenance citation.

excerpt_or_thesis.description: Text excerpt being read aloud, thesis statement, or core inquiry.

artifact_year.description: Year or era associated with the artifact or concept.

dialogue.description: Metadata for invited guest conversations and community roundtables.

topic.description: Discussion topic or pair workbench mandate.

title.description: Title of the episode or discussion topic.

interviewee.description: Name of the featured practitioner or speaker.

role.description: Professional or historical role of the interviewee.

conference.description: Conference or user group event where the interview occurred.

sound_above_prompt.description: The Sound Above philosophical inquiry or central quotation.

companion_links.description: Reference URLs on just3ws.localhost or canonical archives.

host.description: Name and credentials of the stream host.

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the stream.

topic.description: High-level summary topic of the current stream segment.
